name: risk_stat_id
description: Unique primary key for risk analytics snapshot

name: valuation_date
description: Risk valuation calendar date - Partition key

name: valuation_timestamp
description: UTC timestamp of risk calculation engine run

name: date_key
description: Foreign key to dim_date (YYYYMMDD)

name: portfolio_id
description: Trading portfolio book - FK to dim_portfolios, Clustering key

name: risk_regime
description: Assigned regime: LOW_RISK, MODERATE_RISK, ELEVATED_RISK, HIGH_RISK, CRITICAL_BREACH - Clustering key

name: confidence_level
description: Statistical confidence level (0.95 or 0.99) - Clustering key

name: horizon_days
description: Risk horizon holding period in days (typically 1)

name: parametric_var_usd
description: Variance-covariance parametric Value-at-Risk in USD

name: historical_var_usd
description: Historical simulation Value-at-Risk in USD

name: monte_carlo_var_usd
description: Correlated Monte Carlo simulation Value-at-Risk in USD

name: cvar_usd
description: Conditional Value-at-Risk (Expected Shortfall) in USD

name: portfolio_limit_usd
description: Allocated portfolio risk limit in USD

name: var_limit_usd
description: Maximum allowable VaR threshold in USD

name: limit_utilization_pct
description: Percentage utilization of risk limit (parametric_var / var_limit * 100)

name: is_limit_breached
description: Indicator flag if any risk limit threshold was exceeded

name: gross_exposure_usd
description: Sum of absolute market notional position values in USD

name: net_exposure_usd
description: Directional net market delta exposure in USD

name: unrealized_pnl_usd
description: Mark-to-market unrealized profit and loss in USD

name: diversification_benefit_pct
description: Percentage reduction in VaR due to cross-asset correlation offsets

name: hhi_concentration
description: Herfindahl-Hirschman Index measuring portfolio position concentration

name: num_positions
description: Number of open active trading positions in portfolio

name: _source_batch_id
description: Databricks Gold lakehouse execution batch identifier

name: _calculated_at
description: Audit timestamp when record was loaded into BigQuery
